Comparing the Unitree G1 and the Booster K1 puts two popular, compact, next-generation humanoid/bipedal robotics platforms head-to-head. While both target research, development, education, and light commercial/entertainment roles, they differ significantly in size, weight, and configuration.

Key Specifications at a Glance

Feature
Unitree G1 (Base/Standard)
Booster K1
Standing Height
~132 cm (1320 mm)
~95 cm
Weight
~35 kg (with battery)
~19.5 kg
Degrees of Freedom (DoF)
23 DoF (up to 43+ on EDU/Hand configs)
22 DoF total (Legs: 6×2, Arms: 4×2, Head: 2)
Walking Speed
Varies / Agile dynamic movement
Up to 2.0 m/s
AI Compute
NVIDIA Orin NX 16GB (100 TOPS) on EDU variants
~200 TOPS AI compute
Battery / Runtime
~2 hours
~70 mins (5Ah magnetic, direct charging)
Price Range (Approx.)
Starts around €23,000 / $16k–$25k+ depending on tier
~$11,998 (Geek) to $26,998 (Pro)

Design & Portability

Unitree G1: Taller and heavier (~132 cm, 35 kg), built with industrial-grade crossed-roller joints. It can fold down compactly for storage/transport (~69 cm folded height) and possesses a more mature, human-proportioned bipedal frame.

Booster K1: Noticeably smaller and lighter (~95 cm tall, ~19.5 kg) with a built-in carrying handle, making it much easier to pick up, move around classrooms, or toss into a car trunk without heavy lifting.

Articulations & Hands

Unitree G1: Starts at 23 DoF for the base model, scaling up into 29 DoF (Pro/E) or high-dexterity EDU variants featuring 3-finger or 5-finger force-controlled tactile hands (up to 37–43 DoF).

Booster K1: Fixed at 22 DoF total (6 per leg, 4 per arm, 2 in the head), leaning toward a simpler, streamlined kinematic structure rather than ultra-dexterous multi-finger manipulation out of the box.

Computing & Intelligence

Unitree G1: Leverages NVIDIA Orin-based processing options (like the Orin NX 16GB / 100 TOPS on EDU models), paired with deep ecosystem support for VirDyn teleoperation, ROS, and secondary C++/Python development.

Booster K1: Packed with a surprisingly high-throughput AI compute board (~200 TOPS), voice interaction (English/Chinese), built-in agent presets (Soccer, Dance, Chat), and a beginner-friendly "Vibe Coding" / Booster Studio workflow.

Pricing & Tiers

Unitree G1:

Basic / Show model: ~€23,000
Pro / EDU variants scale higher depending on hand/sensor add-ons.

Booster K1:

K1 Geek: ~$11,998
K1 Edu: ~$19,998
K1 Pro: ~$26,998

Which one fits best?

Choose the Unitree G1 if you need a larger, more human-scaled platform, higher potential for advanced multi-finger dexterous hand integration, and an established industrial pedigree.

Choose the Booster K1 if you want a lighter, more portable, budget-friendly desktop/classroom robot with high AI compute per kilo and fast out-of-the-box app/agent interactivity.

Are you looking at these for academic research/software development, educational lab use, or content creation/performance, and do you have a specific budget in mind?
